title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply: Utility Confirmation, Supply Start and Contract End Date
content:
## Utility decision

After a Commercial Natural Gas Supply enrollment is submitted, the gas utility either accepts it, and the utility confirmation date is recorded from its confirmation letter, or rejects it with one of the utility rejection reasons. A rejected enrollment ends permanently.

## Start of supply

Supply begins on the switch meter read date, which becomes the service start date, and the agreement moves from enrollment pending to active.

## Contract end date

For a plan with a term of more than 0 months, the contract end date is the day before the same calendar day the term's number of calendar months after the service start date. When that calendar day does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used before subtracting the day. A month-to-month plan has no contract end date.

### Worked dates (hypothetical service start dates)

| Service start date | Term | Same calendar day after the term | Contract end date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-03-15 | 12 months | 2026-03-15 | 2026-03-14 |
| 2024-01-31 | 24 months | 2026-01-31 | 2026-01-30 |
| 2024-02-29 | 12 months | 2025-02-29 does not exist; 2025-02-28 is used | 2025-02-27 |
| 2023-09-01 | 36 months | 2026-09-01 | 2026-08-31 |
| Any date | 0 months (Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index) | Not applicable | None |

## Points of judgement

**Can a rejected enrollment be revived?** No. A rejected enrollment ends permanently.

**What date does supply start on?** The switch meter read date, recorded as the service start date.
